newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan group moves 112,000T corn tender to Friday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan group moves 112,000T corn tender to Friday.

text.p: Taiwan's Members Feed Industry Group has moved to Friday a tender initially set for Thursday for up to 112,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 or Argentine corn, traders said on Wednesday.
The move, decided less than an hour after the Thursday tender was set, aimed to avoid a scheduling conflict with a big soybean tender that involves some of the same Taiwan buyers, traders said.
The Members Feed Industry Group's main buyers are Taiwan's Formosa Oilseed, Fomau Cereal, Morn Sun Feed Mill and Shin Tai Industry.
